headline: 2 army personnel killed, 1 injured in tank-firing accident during field exercise
summary: Prime Minister Tarique Rahman visited the critically injured army officer at Combined Military Hospital (CMH) following the tragedy in Hathazari, Chattogram.
details: A tank-firing accident during a Bangladesh Army field-firing exercise in Hathazari, Chattogram, has left two army personnel dead and one officer critically injured.
Prime Minister Tarique Rahman visited the Combined Military Hospital (CMH) this afternoon to check on the condition of the injured officer.
The Prime Minister enquired about the patient's physical condition and instructed hospital authorities to ensure the officer receives the best possible treatment.
During the visit, Tarique Rahman spoke with the injured officer and members of his family, wishing him a speedy and full recovery.
The Prime Minister also expressed deep sorrow over the deaths of the two army personnel and conveyed his condolences to their bereaved families.
caption:
Two army personnel killed and one officer critically injured in a tank-firing accident during a field exercise in Chattogram.

A tank-firing accident during a Bangladesh Army field-firing exercise in Hathazari, Chattogram, has left two army personnel dead and one officer critically injured.

Prime Minister Tarique Rahman visited the Combined Military Hospital (CMH) this afternoon to check on the condition of the injured officer.

The Prime Minister enquired about the patient's physical condition and instructed hospital authorities to ensure the officer receives the best possible treatment.

During the visit, Tarique Rahman spoke with the injured officer and members of his family, wishing him a speedy and full recovery.

The Prime Minister also expressed deep sorrow over the deaths of the two army personnel and conveyed his condolences to their bereaved families.

headline: Asif Mahmud sends legal notice to ACC official over graft remarks
summary: Former interim government advisor Asif Mahmud Sajeeb Bhuiyan has demanded the unconditional withdrawal of allegations regarding irregularities in transfers and appointments.
details: Former interim government advisor and NCP spokesperson Asif Mahmud Sajeeb Bhuiyan has sent a legal notice to Anti-Corruption Commission (ACC) spokesperson Akhtarul Islam.
caption:
A legal battle begins as Asif Mahmud challenges the ACC's graft allegations.

Former interim government advisor and NCP spokesperson Asif Mahmud Sajeeb Bhuiyan has sent a legal notice to Anti-Corruption Commission (ACC) spokesperson Akhtarul Islam.
